en: The image shows an old, ornate doorway with an arched stone frame and elaborate carvings above the door. There are three sculpted heads or faces above the arch, and the double doors have decorative panels and the number '8' displayed above them. To the right, a partially visible sign features German text. The window on the left displays patterned glass. The photograph is monochrome and appears historic.
